purpose: Map exact executed worker paths to durable repository inputs without altering executed scripts or rerunning science.

hla.scratchLayout: Copy hla-cryptic-provenance to scratch/checkpoint06-hla-cryptic. Create sibling scratch/checkpoint05-hla and extract the named historical archives into that sibling. Run audit.py with Python standard library. Outputs write only inside scratch/checkpoint06-hla-cryptic.
hla.supplementalIndexReason: audit.py also hashes the reused HTML listing. That exact previously downloaded file was omitted from the prior compressed metadata bundles; it is now archived for execution reproducibility. No new retrieval, selection, peptide scan or result change.
hla.frozenPlan: manifest.json binds original plan.md bytes; those bytes are preserved as plan.original.txt. Current plan.md adds purpose/scope/last_verified metadata only.

methylation.scratchLayout: Copy methylation-denominator into a scratch folder. Verify and extract methylation-identity/metadata-inputs.zip into a separate scratch prior-source directory. Run python audit_denominator.py PATH_TO_PRIOR_SOURCE_DIRECTORY with existing openpyxl; the optional argument overrides the original checkpoint03-methylation default. Outputs write beside the copied script.
methylation.numericSerialization: Value-preserving binary64 text may differ from raw XLSX numeric lexemes; workbook authoritative.

executionBoundary: This maps previously executed and independently checked sources. No changed scientific input or repeat computation is asserted.
